description.text: Techstars’ remote-first Anywhere program was launched in 2017 and supports companies innovating across any industry. The Anywhere model delivers the value of a top-tier Techstars accelerator remotely, to companies in American time zones. Anywhere provides the flexibility to participate in an accelerator program without relocating, and meets for three in-person offsites in startup hubs during the program.

Resources About Techstars Apply Today Home / Techstars Accelerators / Techstars Anywhere Accelerator ACCELERATORS Techstars’ remote-first Anywhere program was launched in 2017 and supports companies innovating across any industry. The Anywhere model delivers the value of a top-tier Techstars accelerator remotely, to companies in American time zones. Anywhere provides the flexibility to participate in an accelerator program without relocating, and meets for three in-person offsites in startup hubs during the program. Get in Touch ABOUT THIS PROGRAM Techstars Anywhere is a remote-first Techstars accelerator with no relocation necessary. Founders follow the proven Techstars approach to accelerate their business and #domorefaster. We are looking for founders who are domain experts building value-generating technologies across industries, with a strong emphasis on robotics, energy, applied and physical AI, materials science, and beyond. The Techstars Anywhere program provides companies in North American timezones the flexibility to participate in an accelerator program without relocating, while still connecting in person through three offsites in VC hubs during the program.
